notes: No first-party ordering platform found (own site eldoradomexicanfood.com has no menu). Read from DoorDash marketplace JSON-LD Menu block (address on page confirms 'Chula Vista', matching our record). Cent distribution is scattered (86% end in .18/.38/.58/.78/.98, not conventional .00/.25/.50/.75/.95/.99) - ran the subtraction test: the same $1.20 protein-tier delta recurs independently in two categories (Quesadilla: plain-protein $15.58 -> premium carne asada/adobada $16.78 -> shrimp $17.98, each +$1.20), which reads as a real tiered-protein pricing structure rather than a computed markup, so filed rather than blocked. 'Most Ordered' carousel (12 items) was diffed against the categorized menu; 6 duplicates dropped, 6 items kept as unique ('Most Ordered (unique)' section): Mexican Coca-Cola, Tilapia (Whole) Fish, Shrimp Ceviche Tostada, Shrimp Cocktail, Mix Cocktail, Aguas Frescas.
